description:
MedVital: an onboard doctor for deep space. Mars is up to 20 min from Earth, so astronauts must catch their own health problems. We're building an app that tracks heart, sleep, radiation and mood, with offline AI that flags changes and tells the crew what to do.

I'm Carl (City Tech, CUNY) on backend + AI. We need data/viz, front-end/UI, a pitch lead and bio/health minds.

Beginners welcome. If you're motivated and want to ship something real in 48 hours, join us at NYU Tandon or online.
